title.narrative: Transforming Systems, Sharing Growth: The Australia–Viet Nam Partnership

description.narrative: This project aims to strengthen inclusive systems in health, care, and SME finance in Viet Nam to address challenges posed by digital transformation, population aging, and climate risks. Implemented by UNDP with WHO technical assistance, it delivers two core components: (1) strengthening health and care foundations, including access to medical products, safe digital health/AI, and integrated older persons care; and (2) advancing innovative SME finance through enhanced data readiness and inclusive public/private financing models. The project actively targets underserved groups—including women and persons with disabilities—to generate sustainable policies, tools, and evidence for national partners.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
